subscription.privacy: We will send you an email to confirm your address (double opt-in); nothing else is sent before you confirm. Your address is only used for these notifications, and every email contains a link to unsubscribe at any time.

channels.unavailable: This status page does not offer this kind of notification at the moment.

webhook.title: Webhook notifications
webhook.subtitle: Post incidents and maintenance to a chat channel or your own endpoint.

help.discord: In Discord: Server settings > Integrations > Webhooks > New webhook > Copy webhook URL.
help.slack: In Slack: create an app with "Incoming Webhooks" and copy the webhook URL of the channel.
help.teams: In Microsoft Teams: Workflows > "Post to a channel when a webhook request is received", then copy the URL.
help.generic: Any https endpoint. Messages are signed (X-OSP-Signature); the key is shown after confirming.

webhook.privacy: We send a message with a 6-digit code to this webhook; your subscription starts once you enter the code. The URL is stored encrypted and only used for these notifications. Every message contains a link to unsubscribe.

sms.title: SMS notifications
sms.subtitle: Get a text message when we post incidents or maintenance.
sms.countries: International format with country code. Allowed: {{codes}}.
sms.privacy: We send an SMS with a 6-digit code to this number; your subscription starts once you enter the code. Your number is stored encrypted and only used for these notifications. Every SMS contains a short link to unsubscribe; you can also reply STOP where your provider supports it.

verify.title: Enter your code
verify.subtitleWebhook: We posted a message with a 6-digit code to your webhook.
verify.subtitleSms: We sent an SMS with a 6-digit code to your number.
verify.help: The code is valid for 24 hours. Nothing arrived after a few minutes? Check the URL or number and subscribe again.

manage.title: Your notifications
manage.subtitle: Choose what you hear about, or unsubscribe.
manage.confirmed: Your subscription is confirmed. You can adjust it here at any time.
manage.signingHelp: Check the X-OSP-Signature header of every message: v1= followed by the hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<X-OSP-Timestamp>.<body>" with this key.
manage.unsubscribeDescription: Stop all notifications to this destination. It is deleted from this status page.
manage.unsubscribedDescription: This destination will not receive any more notifications from us and has been deleted.
